groups.title: Workers' Party of Korea
groups.note: Kim Il Sung remains the starting head of government. The heir is cultivated from 1974, not installed as ruler in 1970.

groups.title: Planning, Power and Living Standards
groups.note: Industrial Korea with real bottlenecks, not a pre-industrial blank slate. Native building employment, fuel, power and maintenance remain active.

groups.title: The Korean People's Army
groups.note: Native defense, personnel and equipment costs remain. No starting units, future technology or free stockpiles are granted.

groups.title: Patrons and the Korean Question
groups.note: Every agreement has a recipient-controlled reply. No forced faction membership, annexation, tribute or aid from another player.

groups.title: Science and the Atomic Question
groups.note: Uses the existing Imperia / Cold War nuclear programme. No automatic uranium output, mines, fissile material or completed weapon.

groups.title: Korean Democratic Party
groups.status: Satellite party; autonomous government is alternate history
groups.note: Use KDP until 1981; KSDP thereafter through a name-only update. It is not an anarchist programme despite its inherited MD slot.

groups.title: Chondoist Chongu Party
groups.status: Satellite party; autonomous government is alternate history
groups.note: Chondoism is an indigenous Korean religion and agrarian tradition, not a Muslim path or an imported theocracy.

groups.title: Cabinet and Planning Commission
groups.note: A cabinet government is alternate history; it is not a new political party. Preserve historical Kim Il Sung at the start.

groups.title: Military Emergency Government
groups.note: A KPA government is an emergency alternative, not historical Songun in 1970. Officers do not inherit all WPK programme bonuses.

groups.title: Yan'an Reform Communist Programme
groups.note: The purged faction has no domestic organization in 1970. Only an actual government change in the existing outlook system opens this programme; no purged leader is revived.

groups.title: Industrial Labour Programme
groups.status: Counterfactual government of a WPK mass organization
groups.note: GFTUK is a state-directed federation, not an independent opposition party in the historical start.

groups.title: Christian Federation Programme
groups.note: KCF is a supervised remnant under Kang Ryang-uk, not a mass Christian party waiting freely to contest power. No automatic conversion of the country.

starting_spirits.description: A developed industrial base is constrained by missed targets, weak input balances and repeated plan extensions.
starting_spirits.remedy: Balance the Inputs removes this spirit after one substantive industrial priority and a funded project.

starting_spirits.title: Power and Imported Inputs
starting_spirits.description: Power shortages and imported machinery and fuel limit the use of installed industrial capacity.
starting_spirits.remedy: Repair the Power Grid removes the electricity/output component. Residual imported-input fuel burden remains until external resilience.

starting_spirits.title: An Uneven Civilian Supply
starting_spirits.description: Civilian supply competes with heavy industry and defence; rural inputs and urban distribution remain uneven.
starting_spirits.remedy: A Sustainable Ration removes this after both irrigation/fertilizer and county clinics. This is not the 1990s famine.

starting_spirits.title: Juche and the Two Patrons
starting_spirits.description: Political autonomy is defended through cautious access to foreign technology and competition between external patrons.
starting_spirits.remedy: Keep Both Doors Open replaces it with strategic autonomy: +6% influence defence / -3% trade opinion; signed external cooperation offsets selected technical disadvantages.

incidents.name: The Machinery Account
incidents.trigger: 730 days after the recorded machinery loan, if its recorded principal remains outstanding.

choices.name: Settle the account
choices.debt: Same principal reduction as the cash debit; one transaction. Normal native borrowing may cover the cash payment.

choices.name: Suspend repayments
choices.debt: Principal remains; normal interest and credit consequences continue.

incidents.note: Only a country that chose the loan can receive this crisis. No automatic historical default in January 1970. Meet the Foreign Bills resolves this account by one chosen response, not necessarily full repayment.

incidents.name: External Support Disrupted
incidents.trigger: A real signed supply/support agreement ceases or its provider changes terms; no forced behavior by SOV or CHI and no automatic calendar punishment.
incidents.mitigation: A signed replacement procurement agreement, or a $2.000 billion spare-parts programme. Patron Resilience halves this temporary penalty.
incidents.note: New NKO event adapter around actual accepted/cancelled cooperation. It models late-Cold-War vulnerability without moving the 1990s famine into 1970.
